name: Electric carving knife
description: A corded kitchen knife with two serrated blades that saw against each other when it runs. Needs mains power.
notes: Modelled switched off; the running state would share this model. No tool quality: a powered cutting quality needs power handling the drafts cannot express. The cord is a short stub with its plug. The box is large because the handle is round.

name: Charcoal water filter
description: A gravity filter: water poured in the top runs down through cloth, charcoal, sand and gravel and out of the tap. The charcoal wears out with use.
notes: The layers are drawn as bands on the outside of a white frame so they read from the iso view; the reservoir is clear blue and the tile draws it opaque. No tool quality: purifying water is a use action on a container, which has no draft field yet. The box is large because it is a cylinder in its bounding box.

name: Charcoal smoker
description: A portable bullet smoker on three legs, with a fuel door at the front and a domed lid. Burns charcoal; coal fumes would spoil the meat.
notes: heating is the quality name used for hotplates. 300 mm across and 600 mm tall to the lid handle, a small real smoker's size, so the shape follows the real thing. Default grain, as it is larger than a shoebox.

name: Charcoal cooker
description: A small steel firebox for coal or charcoal with a pot grate on top, a pilot valve to light it and a flue to carry the fumes away.
notes: The 300 mm longest side is the flue, which rises behind the tank; the box is large because the flue stands off the tank. heating is the quality name used for hotplates.

name: Clay pot
description: A rough hand-built cooking pot of fired clay, open at the top, with two lugs to lift it by.
notes: Qualities use the names other batches use. The box is large because the capacity is inside a round pot with lugs.

name: Clay teapot
description: A round fired-clay teapot with a lid, a spout and a loop handle.
notes: The spout and handle stand well out from a round body, so its bounding box is mostly air.

name: Coffeemaker
description: A drip coffeemaker: water heats in the back tower and drips through the filter basket into a glass carafe on a warming plate. Needs power.
notes: The carafe holds a little coffee, which shows only in game; the tile draws the glass opaque.

name: Crystallizing sugar
description: A small glass of thick sugar syrup with a skewer pegged across the rim, crystals slowly growing on it. Takes about two weeks to set.
notes: The model is the glass a player would pick up, so the box is far larger than the sugar alone. The crystals sit below the rim and show only in game, where the glass is see-through.

name: Food dehydrator
description: A round electric dryer with five stacked trays over a fan and heater base, for drying food to keep. Needs power.
notes: Trays are amber plastic so the stack reads against the white base and lid. No tool quality: drying food is a use action. The box is large because it is a cylinder in its bounding box.

name: Jar of pickling eggs
description: An open glass jar of peeled eggs in brine, still pickling. Seal it once they are done.
notes: Left open; the sealed jar would need its own model with a lid. The whole jar is one item, so the mass includes the glass. The eggs show only through the mouth in the tile, which draws the glass opaque; the brine uses syrup-green for want of a pale pickling-brine finish.

name: Hexamine stove
description: A pocket-sized folding stove that burns solid fuel tablets. Opened out, its two side walls hold up a small pot.
notes: Shown opened out with a fuel tablet on its tray, so it reads as a stove rather than a flat tin; the open box is much larger than the folded one. The vent cut-outs are painted flush. heating is the quality name used for hotplates.

name: Food processor
description: A kitchen motor base under a clear bowl with a chopping blade and a feed tube in the lid. Slices, chops, grinds and mixes. Needs power.
notes: No tool quality. The blade and spindle inside the bowl show only in game, as the tile draws the clear bowl opaque.

name: Petrol stove
description: A pressure stove that burns petrol: a brass tank with a hand pump, a burner on a riser and three legs carrying a pot ring.
notes: The open pot stand and the pump and valve key standing out make the bounding box mostly air. heating is the quality name used for hotplates.

name: Heat pack
description: A sealed chemical pouch that warms up once its tab is pulled. Heats food or eases a sore muscle, once.
notes: Single use; spent, it becomes the used heat pack, which has its own model.

name: Used heat pack
description: A spent chemical heat pack, cold and gone hard in lumps.
notes: A distinct state of the heat pack with its own model: flatter, grey, lumpy and without its pull tab, so the two read apart on the ground.
